Decisions (stage 1, 2026-11-23)

  1. Archive stays in Your move once the work shipped; every other git row goes (A1).
  2. The failing-checks row leaves Your move; the PR row in O3 turns red instead (A2).
  3. O3 lists every PR paseo-prs relates to the workspace (branch, stack, linked); without paseo-prs, the host's branch PR (A3).
  4. With no PR: one "No PR yet" row with the branch facts, branch name muted; opens Changes (A4).
  5. Tree depth: ancestors up to the root, this workspace, direct children with their own child count (A5).
  6. Workspace and agent blockers move into the Tree; PR, person and other blockers stay in the top Blocked by block (A6).
  7. The Tree sits directly after Your move (A7).
  8. The workspace header's git button is out of scope (A8).

Overview tab — area rules

source: spec-overview-tree-ui-overview.md

Area-wide

  • Who. The operator, running 10–30 agent workspaces; their agents handle git and PRs.
  • Device. Desktop: Overview tab in the Explorer sidebar, ~360–480 px wide. Mobile: the workspace sheet, full width. Same content, same order.
  • Rows. Every relation and PR row is one line: a label or name, a muted facts word, a chevron when it opens something. Tones as the app's state words: running accent, waiting warning, blocked/failed danger, done success; idle, archived and not-loaded muted.
  • Sections render nothing when empty: no heading, no "none" placeholder.
  • Live. Rows update in place as other workspaces' status cards and PR facts change; no refresh control.
  • Permissions. None beyond opening the workspace.

Decisions (cards, 2026-11-23)

  1. Children needing you (Waiting, Blocked, Failed) come first, then newest first (A10).
  2. Open PRs all show; merged and closed fold into one "N merged" row; with none open, merged show directly (A11).
  3. Tree group labels: Started by, This workspace, Started, Blocked by, Blocking (A12).
  4. The "This workspace" row shows only with both ancestors and children (A13).

Decisions (atlas, 2026-11-23)

  1. The top blocker block is renamed "Waiting on" (PR, person, other); "Blocked by" is the Tree's group for workspaces and agents (A15).
  2. A linked PR shows its repo name only (paseo-prs#58); the owner only when two repos share a name (A16).
  3. Agents fold into the Tree: on the This workspace row ("· 3 agents"), else an "Agents · 3 here" row; the footer keeps only plugin facts (A18).

O1 Overview tab

P17 states · Explorer panel · 420 (mobile sheet · 390)card text: spec-overview-tree-ui-overview.md

Short

The workspace at a glance: what it is, where it stands, what waits on you, where it sits, its PRs.

Extended

Read top to bottom: Identity (title, goal), Status, Waiting on (PR, person, other blockers), Your move (E1), Tree (O2), Context (E2), Pull requests (O3). Only Your move has buttons. Git is no longer a move: the agent handles it, and PRs show at the end for information.

Get here

Overview tab in the Explorer sidebar; on mobile, the workspace sheet.

Shows

Title; goal as subtitle; state word and summary; Waiting on; Your move rows; Tree (with agents); plugin facts; Pull requests.

Scenarios

Entering a child workspace that waits on an ask: answer it, glance at the parent above, leave. Checking a finished workspace: Status says done, Archive in Your move, the PR row says merged.

Variants

Working (no move, tree and PRs below); waiting on an ask (move first, rest below); done and merged (Archive move, merged PR); a bare workspace with no relations and no PR (only identity and status); mobile sheet of the waiting state.

Edge cases

Status card missing → the state word comes from the agents ("Working", "Idle"), as today. Git status still loading → the Pull requests section is absent until it loads, without a spinner.

O2 Tree

P19 states · Explorer panel · 420 (mobile sheet · 390)card text: spec-overview-tree-ui-overview.md

Short

Where this workspace sits among others: who started it, what it started, what blocks it, what it blocks, and how many agents work in it.

Extended

Up to five groups, each only when it has rows, in this order:

  • Started by — the ancestor chain, root first, down to the direct parent. No indentation: every label and row starts at the same left edge; the order and the group labels carry the hierarchy.
  • This workspace — one highlighted row anchoring the chain; only when there are both ancestors and children. With more than one top-level agent it reads "Impl — tree section · 3 agents" and opens the Lineage tab; otherwise it is not pressable.
  • Agents — "Agents · 3 here", opening the Lineage tab: only with more than one top-level agent and no This workspace row. Placed where This workspace would be (after Started by, before Started).
  • Started — direct children: needing you first (Waiting, Blocked, Failed), then newest first; five shown, then "Show all (N)". A child that started others shows "· 3 started" after its state word.
  • Blocked by — workspaces and agents named in this workspace's status blockedBy (only while the status says blocked). An agent blocker shows the agent's title and its workspace.
  • Blocking — workspaces whose current, blocked status names this workspace or one of its agents. Pressing a workspace row opens that workspace (its Overview); an agent row opens that agent.

Get here

Section of O1, directly after Your move.

Shows

Section label "Tree"; per row: name, state word in its tone ("Working", "Waiting", "Blocked", "Done · PR merged"), chevron.

Scenarios

An impl workspace started by a spec agent: "Started by: Spec — overview rework" above, two review forks below. A workspace waiting on another's PR merge: "Blocked by: Schema — relations model · Working".

Variants

Parent chain + this + children; deep chain (3 ancestors); many children (Show all); blocked by a workspace and an agent; blocking two workspaces; only children (a root); several agents with no This workspace row (Agents row).

Edge cases

An ancestor or child on a host that isn't connected → its last known name, muted, with the word "Not loaded"; not pressable. An archived parent → the row shows "Archived" and still opens it. A blocker workspace that no longer exists → "Removed workspace", muted, not pressable. A workspace that both blocks and is blocked by the same one shows in both groups.

O3 Pull requests

P18 states · Explorer panel · 420 (mobile sheet · 390)card text: spec-overview-tree-ui-overview.md

Short

The PRs this workspace's work lives in, for information.

Extended

Lists every PR paseo-prs relates to the workspace: the branch's PRs, their stack and PRs linked from any repository. Every open PR shows; merged and closed ones fold into one muted "3 merged" row that expands. With no open PR, the merged ones show directly. Each row: #123, title, facts ("2 failing", "changes requested", "approved", "checks running", "checks passing", "merged", "draft"); the most urgent fact wins the tone. A PR from another repository prefixes its repo name (paseo-prs#58); the owner too only when two linked repos share a name. Without paseo-prs installed, the branch's PR from the host's git status. With no PR, one row "No PR yet" with the branch facts ("3 commits · +120 −8 · uncommitted") and the branch name small and muted at the end. No buttons: fixing and merging is the agent's or the asks' job.

Get here

Last section of O1.

Shows

Section label "Pull requests" with a count of all related PRs (merged included) when more than one; the rows above.

Scenarios

A stacked 4-PR feature: all four, the failing one red. A multi-repo change: the paseo PR and the paseo-prs plugin PR, the second shown as paseo-prs#58.

Variants

One open PR with checks passing; failing checks (red) and changes requested; a stack of several PRs with two merged (folded); merged PR; no PR with branch facts; linked PR from another repo.

Edge cases

GitHub unreachable or gh signed out → rows keep their last facts and the section label adds "· not refreshed"; no error block. A branch with nothing to report and no PR → section hidden. The default branch with no PR → section hidden.

Opens

Pressing a branch-PR row opens the PR tab in Explorer; any other PR opens on GitHub. The "No PR yet" row opens the Changes tab.

E1 Your move

P17 states · Explorer panel · 420 (mobile sheet · 390)card text: spec-overview-tree-ui-overview.md

Short

What waits on you, and nothing else.

Extended

Asks, permissions and failed agents in the attention order, as today. Once the work shipped (PR merged, or status card done) and the workspace is a worktree or its PR merged, Archive closes the list. No Create PR, Push, Pull or Merge from base row and no failing-checks row; the PR row in O3 carries those facts.

Get here

Section of O1, after Status and Waiting on.

Shows

Section label "Your move" with a count when more than one; one row open with its buttons, the rest compact.

Variants

One ask open; ask + permission; failed agent; Archive alone after a merge; empty (section hidden) with an unpushed branch, where the old Push row used to be.

Edge cases

The PR merged while an agent still runs → no Archive until the agent stops, as today. Archive fails → the row shows the error under its title and stays.

Short

The remaining one-line facts: plugin facts.

Extended

Loses From, Started and Agents (now O2) and the PR or branch row (now O3). Keeps plugin facts without a status or a move.

Get here

Section of O1, between Tree and Pull requests.

Shows

Unlabelled rows: label, value, chevron.

Variants

Two plugin facts; hidden when there is nothing to say.

Note

None of the installed plugins publish plain facts (paseo-status fills Status, paseo-asks fills Your move), so today the footer stays hidden; it remains for third-party plugins.

Edge cases

None beyond today's.
